schema.content:
Table "Customer_Addresses" {
  "customer_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "premise_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "date_address_from" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "address_type_code" TEXT [not null]
  "date_address_to" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Customer_Orders" {
  "order_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "customer_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "order_status_code" TEXT [not null]
  "shipping_method_code" TEXT [not null]
  "order_placed_datetime" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "order_delivered_datetime" TIMESTAMP
  "order_shipping_charges" TEXT
}

Table "Customers" {
  "customer_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "payment_method" TEXT [not null]
  "customer_name" TEXT
  "customer_phone" TEXT
  "customer_email" TEXT
  "customer_address" TEXT
  "customer_login" TEXT
  "customer_password" TEXT
}

Table "Mailshot_Campaigns" {
  "mailshot_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "product_category" TEXT
  "mailshot_name" TEXT
  "mailshot_start_date" TIMESTAMP
  "mailshot_end_date" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Mailshot_Customers" {
  "mailshot_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "customer_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "outcome_code" TEXT [not null]
  "mailshot_customer_date" TIMESTAMP
}

Table "Order_Items" {
  "item_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "order_item_status_code" TEXT [not null]
  "order_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "product_id" INTEGER [not null]
  "item_status_code" TEXT
  "item_delivered_datetime" TIMESTAMP
  "item_order_quantity" TEXT
}

Table "Premises" {
  "premise_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "premises_type" TEXT [not null]
  "premise_details" TEXT
}

Table "Products" {
  "product_id" INTEGER [pk]
  "product_category" TEXT [not null]
  "product_name" TEXT
}



Ref: "Customer_Addresses"."customer_id" > "Customers"."customer_id"

Ref: "Customer_Addresses"."premise_id" > "Premises"."premise_id"

Ref: "Customer_Orders"."customer_id" > "Customers"."customer_id"

Ref: "Mailshot_Customers"."mailshot_id" > "Mailshot_Campaigns"."mailshot_id"

Ref: "Mailshot_Customers"."customer_id" > "Customers"."customer_id"

Ref: "Order_Items"."order_id" > "Customer_Orders"."order_id"

Ref: "Order_Items"."product_id" > "Products"."product_id"
